settings.label: Page Layout Gap
settings.info: Controls spacing (gaps) throughout the site. Use the CSS variable --gap in your styles.

settings.label: Bento Gap
settings.info: Gap between items in Bento Grid sections. Use the CSS variable --bento-gap in your styles.

settings.label: Padding
settings.info: Horizontal padding for page content. Use the CSS variable --page-layout-padding in your styles.

settings.label: Header navigation item gap
settings.info: Gap between navigation items in the header sidebar.

settings.label: Header button gap
settings.info: Gap between action buttons (e.g. cart, account, search) in the header.

settings.label: Trigger point
settings.info: How early animation starts before the section fully enters the viewport.

settings.label: Disable scroll animations on mobile
settings.info: When enabled, all scroll animations are skipped on mobile screens (≤768px).

settings.label: Mobile trigger point
settings.info: How early scroll animations start on mobile. Lower values trigger sooner.

settings.content: Sale badge colors are set per color scheme under Theme settings → Colors → each scheme → Sale Badge.

settings.label: Search input icon (image)
settings.info: Icon in the search field on the search page. Leave empty for default magnifying glass.

settings.label: Search input icon (SVG)
settings.info: Paste SVG code for a custom icon. Use 'currentColor' to match theme. Ignored if image is set.

settings.label: Additional CSS
settings.info: Use CSS that targets the design token variables.
